<noinclude>
Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Navbox
History: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Navbox&action=history
Revision: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Template:Navbox&oldid=1030560841 (06/26/2021 6:05 PM UTC)
Adapted by phpBB Modders.
Changes: rewritten in plain wiki text without Lua (Module:Navbox) as a box the reader opens and closes (the wiki's details and summary tags, wiki extension 1.1.0-a2 and later): title, above, below and 20 numbered rows, each a group with its list or a list alone (a group without a list is left out); it starts closed, and state=expanded starts it open, instead of Wikipedia's autocollapse; no view, talk and edit links, image, child navboxes, class, style or list numbering options; removed the source's documentation and categories.
Example: {{Navbox|title=Wiki features|state=expanded|group1=Pages|list1=[[Main Page]] · [[Help]]|group2=Tools|list2=[[Search]] · [[Recent changes]]|below=More on the wiki}}
Example: {{Navbox|title=Short|state=expanded|list1=Just one list}}
